685b0a11-66b1-49d5-c91a-d646716c6a1d.title: Flower
685b0a11-66b1-49d5-c91a-d646716c6a1d.description: An animated 🌻 that blooms random blossoms for Bees to collect.

params.note: When the grow animation finishes, randomly switch to one of three art frames, corresponding to different colors, and add the tag “bloom” so that it’s ready to be “collected”
When flower is marked as “collected”, switch to the art frame depicting a picked flower
If the bee collides with the flower, and the flower is finished blooming, mark the flower as having been “collected”
After a random delay, start playing the flower growing animation
